WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2023-12-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month, gross_revenue,
       gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_increase
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled') AS non_cancelled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status = 'Returned')::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'), 0) AS return_rate
FROM public.order_items oi
JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id
JOIN public.products p ON p.id = ii.product_id
WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled') >= 100
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

sql:
SELECT dc.name, ROUND((SUM(oi.sale_price - ii.cost))::numeric, 2) AS gross_margin
FROM public.order_items oi
JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id
JOIN public.distribution_centers dc ON dc.id = ii.product_distribution_center_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH u AS (
  SELECT id, created_at FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
o AS (
  SELECT u.id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM u
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi
    ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY u.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count >= 2)::double precision / COUNT(*) AS share
FROM o

SELECT u.traffic_source,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id),0))::numeric, 2) AS revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at))/3600.0) AS median_hours
FROM public.order_items
WHERE status = 'Complete' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END),0)::numeric,2) AS net_revenue
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
